Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000600": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman (Tomasz left the Atlas team on 2025-07-30 to join the Dune team).  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000594": Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000582": As of 2025-07-30, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team on-call rotation, taking over from Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000578": As of 2025-07-30, Tomasz leaves the Atlas team and joins the Dune team.  (about: Atlas team, Tomasz, Dune team)
- memory_id "1000571": The Dune team sits on the fourth floor.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000548": The billing API is owned by the Atlas team as of 2025-06-09, having moved from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000514": The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-27; the earlier handover note of 2025-06-11 saying Cinder took ownership was written against the wrong team, and Cinder never owned it.  (about: Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000506": The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, having moved from the Ember team.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000501": On 2025-06-25 Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler runbook)
- memory_id "1000456": The job scheduler's single fixed node turned every restart into a missed run.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000453" [decision]: On 2025-06-06 the Ember team decided that the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000368": As of 2025-04-29, the job scheduler still relies on the feature-flags service.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000364": As of 2025-04-24, the Cinder team reported that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: Cinder, feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000349" [decision]: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.  (about: Dune team)
- memory_id "1000286": On 2025-03-26 the Dune team observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000284" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000183": The job scheduler depends on the feature-flags service for per-job kill switches.  (about: feature-flags, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000177" [constraint]: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000130": The reporting service is owned by the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000101": Farah has the first on-call rotation for the Dune team.  (about: Farah, Dune team)
